bio.text: Bryan Shupe represents District 36 in the Delaware House of Representatives.
Shupe was born and raised in Milford, graduated from Milford High School, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Delaware.
Before joining the House, Shupe served on the Milford city council and as the city's mayor for four years.
Shupe started the community internet outlet Milford Live and later opened FurBaby Boutique & Doggie Daycare in downtown Milford with Shupe's wife, Sherry.
